top_band: grey tiled roof slope (rows 1-14) and stone water basin top rim/water surface (rows 29-35)
evidence: Both the canopy roof (rows 1-14) and the lower stone water basin (rows 29-35) clearly show their top horizontal/sloping surfaces seen from above, with front edge lines, eave shadows (rows 16-17 and row 36), and vertical posts/front faces below.

style.evidence: While the roof has decent tile shading (5 steps), the wooden posts (rows 17-43) are completely flat two-tone bands without grain, and the stone basin (rows 29-42) is made of large flat fills of solid grey and blue with no stone texture or masonry detail, unlike the richly textured stonework of the reference well. Heavy near-black outlines surround all shapes.
